purpose: Teach: 催眠/列挙/傾斜/海賊/聴覚/電磁波/服用/墜落

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、催眠療法を医療チームで研究しております
lines.en: Ren, we've been researching hypnotherapy as part of our medical team's work.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Professional warmth without distance. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone sharing their actual work with genuine interest in being understood.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 症状を列挙して、貴院でカルテに記録されますね、先生
lines.en: So patients list their symptoms and you record them in the hospital charts, right, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Soft curiosity — genuinely interested in how the system works, not challenging. Slight uptick at the end, checking for confirmation. Respectful but engaged.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、傾斜の急な階段は患者さんに危険なので医療チームでも気をつけます
lines.en: Yes, and steep stairs are actually a risk for patients, so our team is careful about that too.
lines.style: Steady explanation. Brief acknowledgment of his point before moving forward. No rush. The voice of someone who has explained logistics many times and still means it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療機器の海賊版に貴院も注意されているそうですね、先生
lines.en: I've heard your hospital is also vigilant about counterfeit medical equipment, Doctor?
lines.style: Gentle probe — not accusatory, genuinely wondering. Respectful framing as a question. Small hesitation before 'counterfeit' like he's choosing the right word. Interested in her response.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、聴覚障害の患者さんを医療チームでサポートします
lines.en: Yes, we make sure to support patients with hearing impairments as part of our team's approach.
lines.style: Warm affirmation. Slight emphasis on 'support' — this matters to her. Even, unhurried pace. The tone of someone whose work includes real people, not just protocols.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 電磁波の人体影響を、貴院も研究なさったんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital has actually researched electromagnetic radiation's effects on the human body, then?
lines.style: Respectful curiosity with genuine interest. Soft exploratory tone — asking what she knows, not testing her. Small nod in the voice. Seeking connection through understanding her work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、薬の服用方法を患者さんに丁寧に説明します
lines.en: Yes, and we always explain medication instructions to patients carefully and clearly.
lines.style: Direct, grounded statement. Quiet emphasis on 'carefully' — this is non-negotiable to her. Warm but professional. The confidence of someone who prioritizes how things are said.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、墜落事故の救急対応もご経験ですね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital has experience with emergency response to crash trauma, I imagine?
lines.style: Soft, respectful inquiry. A small catch of recognition — understanding the weight of what he's asking. Genuine curiosity about her experience, not grim fascination. Trails slightly, inviting her in.
